youtube.description:
Uncle ne poocha: "Spinal ke baad sir mein dard kyun?" 🤕
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Uncle, ghabraiye mat, yeh kam hota hai, aur ilaaj hai! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Spinal ki sui ki jagah se thoda sa paani (fluid) rishne se yeh sirdard hota hai; 100 mein kareeb 1 ya usse kam logon ko
✅ Letne par aaraam milta hai, baithne ya khade hone par badhta hai
✅ Aam taur par 1 din se 1 hafte ke andar shuru hota hai
✅ Paani peejiye, anaesthesia doctor ko bataiye; iska ilaaj maujood hai
Sirdard ke saath bahut neend, confusion ya ulti ho toh turant doctor ko dikhaiye. Koi bhi dawa apne doctor se poochh kar hi lijiye.
